correctness.rationale: For T(theta)=theta+omega-s sin(theta+gamma), derivative 1-s cos gives analytic diffeomorphism for |s|<1, one order-three degeneracy at |s|=1 with third derivative equal to 1, and two nondegenerate folds for |s|>1 with absolute second derivative sqrt(s²-1). Poisson-law-to-Poisson-law orientation-preserving homeomorphisms must be Möbius because conjugation by boundary automorphisms preserves Haar and hence is rotation. A nonrotation Möbius derivative has a second harmonic absent from 1-s cos; only s=0 closes. Change of variables yields the critical cusp coefficient 2P_a(c)/6^(2/3), fold coefficient P_a(c)sqrt(2/absolute second derivative) and strict L^p cutoffs 3/2,2. Independent numerical local cubic ratios at source displacements 0.06,0.03,0.01 are 1.03390,1.01737,1.00588 and converge correctly. These checks corroborate the analytic asymptotics, not the all-s proof.
